locations.name: Apollo Aggregates warehouse
locations.summary: About $10,000 in marked bills, two or three weapons, and a Leroy Rook collectible card.
locations.hint: East / south-east of Hamlet. Three large rectangular pools beside the highway, long red warehouse at the bend. Grey door beside the Apollo trailer.

locations.name: Manatee Motel
locations.summary: Laird 350 sniper rifle and a cash safe on the top floor.
locations.hint: South-west of Hamlet on the eastern edge of the Gullet Marsh, north-east of Cottonmouth Lake. Top-floor room holds the weapon.

locations.name: Three Sheets Liquor — parrot stash
locations.summary: Cash hidden in an air vent behind the exotic-pet yard. The macaw marks the spot.
locations.hint: Key Lento, just north of the Pay 'n' Spray. Down the alley right of the storefront, through the broken chain-link. Vent beside the generator in the back corner.

locations.name: Steven Strachan Construction
locations.summary: Georgia collectible card (NINE1NINE Dancers set) on boxes in the back room.
locations.hint: Sunbelt Hwy in central Key Lento, across from Sunset Dr. Use the rear entrance; card sits on boxes next to a green container.

locations.name: Palmer Fishing Warehouse
locations.summary: Safe with ~$3,000, a Gold KZ-59, and the safe code on the ground-floor computer.
locations.hint: Bobcat Key, off Watson Bay — south end of the key. Safe is upstairs in the lounge corner; read the code off the computer downstairs first.
tips: Read the code off the ground-floor computer before going upstairs — the safe will not open otherwise.
Sources disagree between 1886 and 1887; try 1886 first, then 1887.
Arrive by boat; the key has no road in.

locations.name: Permit Keys wrecks
locations.summary: Suppressed Assassin Nipper .38 and a Smuggler Gorse 425 shotgun on two separate islands.
locations.hint: Two islands. Suppressed pistol in deck hatch on the Derelict Spy Vessel wreck at the south-east Permit Keys tip. Shotgun on the sand beside a tilted boat on the northernmost island. Boat or jet ski required.

locations.name: Wetman Bay fishing shacks
locations.summary: Kingfishers W-22 in a case on the kitchen counter of the main shack.
locations.hint: Middle island in Wetman Bay, west of Pelican Valley and north-west of Key Lento. The W-22 sits in a case on the kitchen counter of the salmon-red main house over the dock.

locations.name: Pelican Valley research outpost
locations.summary: Safe (~$1,000–$1,100), $10,000 in marked bills in the boathouse, and a Crabshack VF5 SMG.
locations.hint: Medium island in south-west Pelican Valley, north of the Keys. Boat only. 0072 is the safe code; 0212 is the boathouse keypad. PC password reported as CLEAVES.
tips: Two different codes: 0072 is the safe, 0212 is the boathouse keypad. Do not mix them up.
The PC password (CLEAVES) is reported separately from both codes.
Boat only — the outpost island has no road access.

locations.name: Abandoned site north of the airstrip
locations.summary: Alien bunker and UFO encounter content. Keypad code is dream-derived and may differ per save.
locations.hint: North-east of Cottonmouth Lake and south of Hamlet, at the north end of the long airstrip. Keypad code 2314 is commonly reported but can vary.
tips: 2314 is the commonly reported code but it may differ per save — if it fails, the code is dream-derived, not found in the world.
Anchor on the north end of the airstrip, then walk north-east toward the bunker.
No firm confirmation of what the bunker leads to; treat the outcome as unverified.

locations.name: Kingpin Bowling safe
locations.summary: Cash safe and a Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun via the Kolt & Associates robbery.
locations.hint: Southern Port Gellhorn on US-9, just south of the Pawn & Gun. Safe is in the back office. All three Port Gellhorn codes are written on the wall map at Brooks Boatworks.
rewards: Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (via Kolt & Associates robbery)
tips: Most guides say 0300; one says 0330. Try 0300 first.
All three Port Gellhorn codes are written on the wall map at Brooks Boatworks — read them there instead of guessing.
The Gutterball shotgun is elsewhere in the building, not inside the safe.

locations.name: Brooks Boatworks
locations.summary: Clunker 556 carbine, an upstairs safe, and a wall map listing all three Port Gellhorn codes.
locations.hint: Northern Port Gellhorn waterfront near the bridge to Draper Island. Enter through the east fence hole, climb the grey building's outside stairs to the room with the wall map (codes: 6823, 6969, 0300).
tips: The outside stairs are the way in — the front is sealed.
Read the wall map while you are here: it lists 6823, 6969 and 0300 for the whole Port Gellhorn set.

locations.name: La Cascara Motel
locations.summary: Scrapper VF5C SMG, $15,000, and a safe (code 6969) in the gated top-floor room.
locations.hint: Western Port Gellhorn shoreline on Draper Bay, south of the rail bridge to Draper Island, near Wild Hog Point.
tips: The room is gated and guarded; clear the floor before opening the safe.
Approach from the Draper Bay shoreline, south of the rail bridge.

locations.name: The couch in the tree
locations.summary: Couch Potato Mustang .357 revolver. Shoot the ropes to drop the couch from the tree.
locations.hint: Tanglewood Ln in Port Gellhorn, outside a mobile home. A couch hangs from a tree — shoot the ropes to drop it, then search it.

locations.name: Meteorite at Hillside Campsite
locations.summary: Meteorite item in a shallow crater between the tents. Purple smoke marks the spot.
locations.hint: Eastern side of Mount Kalaga National Park, near Hillside Campsite south-west of Dawson Dam. Purple smoke marks the spot, roughly halfway up the trail.

locations.name: Dog Island — jet-ski dog
locations.summary: $1,218 wallet found after following Cool Dog's jet ski to Dog Island.
locations.hint: Ride Cool Dog's jet ski and stay on it — the dog leads you to the island south of Bobcat Key. An upturned boat marks the landing.

locations.name: Glider in the treeline
locations.summary: Turnt Nipper .38 pistol on a powered paratrike hung in the pines.
locations.hint: Bobcat Bight, northern tip of the Mariana coast. A powered paratrike is hung in a pine — shoot the lines to bring it down, then take the pistol off the seat.

locations.name: Janjak's Garage — office safe
locations.summary: San4San weed garage in La Perle. Office safe (code 4444) plus a pink Declasse Gin Tulip and the San4San KZ-59 rifle in the building.
locations.hint: La Perle, Vice City. The safe is in the office of the San4San garage. The code is written on a note stuck to the office fridge — read it before you open anything.
tips: The code is on the office fridge — you can read it without triggering the robbery.
The Gin Tulip and the KZ-59 are elsewhere in the garage, not in the safe.
Pin is a region-level estimate; the guide names La Perle, not coordinates.

locations.name: Black Eagle warehouse — door & safe
locations.summary: Six-digit door and safe codes, and a Kalinga .50 pistol in the safe.
locations.hint: The door keypad takes 789987 and the safe inside takes 031462. Two different six-digit codes — do not swap them.
tips: Both codes are six digits; the door one is the one that looks like a pattern.
Pin is a region-level estimate — the guide does not give a street address.

locations.name: Red Apple Orchard garage
locations.summary: Garage keypad hides the Applesauce Bobcat vehicle.
locations.hint: The garage door runs on keypad code 360782. Punch it in and drive the Bobcat out.
tips: Six digits — the only six-digit code at this location.
Pin is a region-level estimate; verify before driving out.

locations.name: Cottonmouth Lake trailer
locations.summary: Free-roam safe on the sandbar island south of the lake.
locations.hint: Trailer on the sandbar island just south of Cottonmouth Lake. The code is a five-digit one shown on the postcards beside the bed.
tips: Five digits, which is unusual — do not pad it with a leading zero.
Read the postcards by the bed if the safe rejects the code.
Anchor: use the Cottonmouth Lake label on the map, then look south to the sandbar.

locations.name: Watson Bay safehouse
locations.summary: Security-compound safe tucked under the microwave.
locations.hint: Watson Bay, near Bobcat Key. The safe is under the microwave in the kitchen. The code is the last line of an email on the kitchen PC.
tips: The compound is guarded — clear it before you start reading the PC.
Turn the microwave over; the safe is underneath it, not behind it.

locations.name: Nova Auto Junkyard safe
locations.summary: Junkyard safe outside Hamlet. Code is memorable, which is the hint.
locations.hint: Nova Auto Junkyard, Hamlet. Four repeated digits — the most memorable code in the game, easy to overlook because it looks too obvious.
tips: Four identical digits; if a code does not stick, look for the safe rather than the clue.
Hamlet is the anchor label on the map — the yard sits on its edge.

sources.label: Rock Paper Shotgun — all safe codes

locations.name: Delights Cabaret office safe
locations.summary: Office safe in the Port Gellhorn club. The code arrives by text, not by note.
locations.hint: Delights Cabaret, Port Gellhorn. You do not find this code in the world — Vicki texts it to you during the 'Afternoon Delight' mission. If you skipped the mission, the safe stays shut.
tips: Mission-gated: check your phone messages if the keypad ignores you.
The code is also the year the club was founded, per in-game signage.

sources.label: Rock Paper Shotgun — all safe codes

locations.name: Dino Golf — Brontasaurus Bat
locations.summary: Batting-cage melee weapon at the abandoned mini-golf on SR-32.
locations.hint: Dino Golf at Frogswater, off SR-32. Walk into the batting cage on the right-hand side of the abandoned attraction; the bat is propped inside.
tips: There is no code and no fight — it is a walk-up pickup, easy to miss because the cage looks closed.
Pin is a region-level estimate; guides name Frogswater and SR-32 without coordinates.

locations.name: Kingfishers' Sunrise RV Park
locations.summary: Akulus 'Kingfishers' heavy revolver inside a trailer during the raid on the illegal operation.
locations.hint: The trailer in the RV park. It appears during the Chapter 3 raid on the Kingfishers' illegal operation — the game shows 'Valuables found' when you are next to it.
tips: Chapter 3 raid only; in free roam the trailer is empty.
Search the trailers in order — the revolver is in the one that triggers the 'Valuables found' prompt.

locations.name: Final Chapter compound — KVGA-12
locations.summary: KVGA-12 'Final Chapter' automatic shotgun in the Final Chapter gang's Ambrosia territory.
locations.hint: Ambrosia, in the Final Chapter's area. Go in heavy — the compound is defended, and the shotgun sits inside rather than on a rack outside.
tips: Treat it as an assault, not a pickup: bring armour and a rifle.
Ambrosia is a named region on the map, so use the region filter to frame the search.

locations.name: Gullet Marsh hut — Akulus & SM-69
locations.summary: Two unique weapons in one spot: an Akulus revolver inside the hut and an SM-69 sniper on the planks outside.
locations.hint: Wooden hut east of the abandoned crab lab in Gullet Marsh. The Akulus revolver is next to a body inside, with a phone playing a video. The SM-69 sniper is on the planks in front of the same hut, ammunition included.
tips: Two pickups, one building — check the planks outside before you leave.
Use the crab lab outpost as the anchor; this hut is immediately east of it.
The phone by the body plays a short video; it is part of the find, not a clue.

locations.name: The literal Easter egg nest
locations.summary: A bird's nest full of painted eggs at the top of the tallest TV tower, plus a parachute one level up.
locations.hint: Tallest TV tower in Vice-Dale County, south Vice City. Find the ladder at the foot of the tower and keep climbing — expect six to fifteen minutes. Take an egg from the nest and throw it off the ledge at full power for a cutscene.
rewards: Free parachute one level above the nest
Backyard Wrestling card on the way up (reported)
tips: Budget real time for the climb — guides clock it at six to fifteen minutes of ladders.
Throw the egg at full power off the edge, or nothing happens.
There is a base jump from the platform above, and a free parachute to go with it.
Pin is a region-level estimate; guides place the tower in Vice-Dale County without coordinates.

locations.name: UFO abduction on the back road
locations.summary: Player-reported night abduction east of Port Gellhorn, near the Starlet Motel. No published trigger.
locations.hint: Back road east of Port Gellhorn, near the Starlet Motel. Reported after Chapter 2, around 2 a.m. in-game time: follow the trail from the abandoned car into the woods.
tips: Player reports only — nobody has published a reliable trigger, so treat it as a rumour.
If you go looking, set the in-game clock to about 02:00 and drive the back road slowly.
Pin is a region-level estimate and the encounter is unconfirmed.

locations.name: Search for the Skunk Ape
locations.summary: Hidden side mission: find Kirk's flyers, follow his drone through the swamp at night, then hunt the effigies.
locations.hint: Look for Kirk's flyers around Leonida — they add him to your contacts. Meet him at Pelican River at night, follow his drone into the swamp (Gullet Marsh / south of Cottonmouth Lake), then search Pelican Valley for the dolls carved into trees.
rewards: Skunk Ape side story with a choice at the end
tips: Night only — the meeting will not start in daylight.
Use Focus Mode in the mangroves; you lose the creature on purpose the first time.
The dolls carved into trees come after the chase, not during it.
Guides disagree on the exact marsh, so the pin is an area, not a spot.

locations.name: The crab lab — Karkinos
locations.summary: Abandoned research outpost in the middle of Gullet Marsh where someone experimented on crabs. A diary names Karkinos.
locations.hint: Middle of Gullet Marsh, the research outpost on the medium island in south-west Pelican Valley. Read the diary on the PC — it tells of a giant crab called Karkinos — then work the safe and the boathouse. This is the same outpost as the Pelican Valley stash entry; that pin covers the loot, this one covers the story.
rewards: Free-roam access to the outpost safe and boathouse
tips: Read the PC diary before you touch the safe — the password and both codes come from the same trail.
Boat only; there is no road onto the island.
Chapter 3 is when most players reach it, though the island is reachable earlier.
